City of Abbotsford 2026 PROPERTY TAX NOTICE. total 129,460.47 verified: printed 12x as '2026 TOTAL TAXES & OTHER CHARGES' and 'TOTAL OUTSTANDING TAXES', identical, so nothing is carried forward -- a genuinely large commercial parcel, not a mis-read. payment_due_date from 'DUE DATE: Thursday, July 2, 2026'. || invoice_date is deliberately NOT asserted: this page prints NO issue-date label at all (no Invoice/Billing/Statement/Notice/Issue Date), so build_write_values substitutes date.today() and the run wrote 2026-08-27. `regress.py --add` proposed it as 'stable' only because all three replicates ran on the same day -- a false green that would flip red tomorrow. The defaulting itself is the open A1/A6 defect class, not something this sidecar should lock in. payment_due_date IS asserted because the page prints it explicitly. || account_number NOT asserted: measured UNSTABLE across the three replicates, which disagreed on formatting only ('6170066209' twice, '61700-6620-9' once) -- same digits, so a cosmetic normalisation gap (open-defects class D2), not a wrong value. || invoice_description NOT asserted: free-text summary that rewords every run ('Annual property tax charges for 2026.' vs '2026 property tax notice.'), excluded by the standing rule already recorded on recommend_240124_0001. It was asserted in error when this sidecar was scaffolded from only 3 replicates, all of which happened to agree. || vendor_name IS asserted. The twins return the correct municipality on every read but flip between title case and upper case ('City of Abbotsford' / 'CITY OF ABBOTSFORD'); regress.py compares vendor_name case-insensitively (and suffix-insensitively) for exactly this reason, so the assertion still catches a WRONG vendor while ignoring a difference the pipeline does not promise. The casing itself is open-defects B6a, owned by dataverse-todo DV-4. vendor_name is base-critical and is never dropped from a sidecar.
